account_deletion_tombstones.reason: Durable account-deletion fence. Content deletion leaves it unchanged; it intentionally survives account deletion without an auth FK so late requests cannot recreate deleted account data.

llm_consent_receipts.reason: Private provenance and withdrawal state for the retained consent_records ledger. Content deletion preserves it and cannot restore collect-mode legacy access; deletion of the account or source consent record cascades the receipt.

polaris_generations.reason: Polaris lifetime allowance and request replay ledger. Content deletion clears evidence hashes and derived cards, fails and refunds active requests; terminal account deletion cascades the ledger.

reward_ssv_issue_rate_limits.reason: Bounded rewarded-ticket issuance counter. Content deletion must not reset the issuance limit; account deletion cascades the counter through public.users.

0242_profile_context_import_integrity.sq.profile_context_imports.field_undo: Content/source withdrawal restores matching fields; retain withdrawn ancestors only while reachable from an active batch, then clear. Account deletion cascades the row.
0242_profile_context_import_integrity.sq.users.profile_import_attempt_day: Retain through content deletion; remove with account.
0242_profile_context_import_integrity.sq.users.profile_import_attempt_count: Bounded daily attempt counter; content deletion cannot reset it; remove with account.
